column7: When tidying old Secuura/Blockchain storage: follow the approved policy (1_Project_Definition/Policies/2026-10-19_secuura-blockchain-storage-policy.md): only its named classes and predicates, dry-run first, removal by the project's seat. Else never delete.

-> 2026-10-18_model-routing-v10-approved-route-by-the-table.md: 'Spark/Ornith/Sonnet only until Monday, no new Opus' was overridden the same day and its end event (Mon 2026-10-12) has passed. Route by fleet/specs/model-routing.md.

A Secuura ticket goes Done when tested, working and deployed on Kintsugi: make the live check where possible; if none, unit tests green on develop + fix in running build + comment 'no live check possible'. A ticket naming a live run stays open. Never idle.

When Tuesday boots, rotates or respawns: do not wait for Kam; sweep Datasec boards for actionable tickets (no new word, ruling or production touch), partition into disjoint lanes, launch in waves. Signature classes and gates stand; ruling-blocked go to cards.
